title: Sorn the Loomkeeper
html:
Sorn the Loomkeeper is a named Bandit seen at level 25 (mage).

Wearing

The Banker outfit, and

torso Fine Shirt Charcoallegs Fine Trousersfeet Buckled Shoesmain hand Oak Staff

Where to find Sorn the Loomkeeper

  • Inside The Hollow Loom · seen 2×

What it can drop

  • Silkstep Boots (unique Werewolfpelt Feet): 2% of kills (1 in 50), 10% from an elite (1 in 10). Moving in a fight with a bow or crossbow costs 20% less stamina.
  • Gear every kill: a piece from its tier, excellent or better, and a second piece 1 kill in 5.
  • Gold worth about 5 ordinary kills.
  • Enchanted: 1 kill in 100 enchants a piece (up to 9c, and only what its material can hold).
  • Elite: a boss spawns elite 1 time in 100, and an elite makes its unique 5 times as likely.

From the game’s rules and its own guide. See Unique items.
